entities.name: Neneh MacDouall-Gaye
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Neneh MacDouall-Gaye is a Gambian politician and diplomat. She served as Yahya Jammeh's last Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2015 to 2017 and as Gambian Ambassador to the United States in 2009.
